payload.explanation: The diagnostic report traces the lock chain: the business decrement (session_bda0d96099e1) is blocked via an intermediate session by the upstream root blocker session_a34e1ccef072, an idle-in-transaction session holding an uncommitted UPDATE on inventory. The state report confirms session_a34e1ccef072 is eligible for rollback_session and that the business request is still pending (stock=200, expected 199). Rolling back the root blocker releases the chain and lets the decrement complete, while preserving the business request and unrelated transactions; no evidence supports large-data, index, or vacuum causes.
